speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng
text: asked the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (a) what are the major reasons for the sharp decline in the number of dengue cases reported in 2025; and (b) when will the Project Wolbachia trial be extended to all the towns in Singapore.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Goh Hanyan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
text: NEA will continue to monitor the progress of Project Wolbachia and adjust its deployment strategy.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Goh Hanyan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
text: Reducing dengue risks in our community requires the cooperation and support of residents.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Goh Hanyan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
text: We seek residents' understanding that more mosquitoes may be seen during the release periods of male Wolbachia-carrying mosquitoes, but these mosquitoes are necessary to help suppress the Aedes Aegypti population and do not bite or transmit disease.

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast-Jurong West)
text: Is it the main reason for the significant drop in dengue cases last year?

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast-Jurong West)
text: If so, I would ask another supplementary question.

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast-Jurong West)
text: Because at one point, Nanyang was considered a dengue red zone and quite a number of residents shared with me the agony of getting dengue fever.

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast-Jurong West)
text: I have appealed to NEA to extend the Wolbachia trial to Nanyang, which is in Jurong West.

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast-Jurong West)
text: And indeed, NEA has extended the trial to Jurong West, but stopped short of reaching Nanyang.

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast-Jurong West)
text: So, I have also checked the NEA website just a while ago to confirm this, the extension of the trial.

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast-Jurong West)
text: Since NEA has considered the Wolbachia trial to be effective, what is the bottleneck that is preventing NEA from expanding the Wolbachia trial faster to Nanyang and the rest of Singapore?

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast-Jurong West)
text: And even by the end of this year, NEA is only covering 50% of households.

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast-Jurong West)
text: So, how could NEA add more resources to expand the trial of Wolbachia faster and better?

speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
text: He had a couple, so I will answer the first one on whether Project Wolbachia was the main reason for the decline in dengue cases in 2025.

speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
text: However, I would also like to say that it is not a silver bullet for suppressing the mosquito population and managing dengue risk.

speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
text: Sustained vigilance and collective responsibility by the community is important to prevent mosquito breeding and remains critical to reduce the risk of dengue transmission.

speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
text: All of this, collectively, including the combined impact of NEA's comprehensive strategy, rather than that as a single intervention, has helped to lower the number of dengue cases.

speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
text: In short, it is one of the reasons, but it is not the only reason why we are seeing a decline last year.

speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
text: On the other question, I thank the Member for raising the request on behalf of his residents.

speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
text: In terms of site selection, site selection on areas to receive the Wolbachia Aedes mosquito release is based on multiple considerations, including historical dengue situations and the current Aedes Aegypti mosquito population.

speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
text: So, there are many factors in play and it is on a relative basis across different locations in Singapore.

speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
text: NEA will announce the new sites in due course, so we take note of the Member's request.

speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
text: The other question was around what are the constraints?

speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
text: So, it is a matter of figuring out how effective our current site releases have been.
